_comment: NPCs who barter: their «Intercambiar» opens the exchange window of type 2 (kbn), where the
player lays things and the NPC answers with what it gives for them (Handlers/NpcBarterHandler).
A recipe is taken when what lies on the table is exactly its price, or a whole multiple of it.
{ npc, recipes: [ { gives: [ { item, count } ], takes: [ { item, count } ] } ], why }

barters.why: Gobiere Trokeur in his hut [-6,4] of the goblins' camp, «Tú dar II o III meados bworks, yo dar a ti buen ñam ñam» (3501): «2 x Bière de Bwork donne 1 x Oeuf de piou, 3 x Bière de Bwork donne 1 x Pain du Pinchaut, 16 x Bière de Bwork donne 1 x Gratrooll Industriel, 20 x Bière de Bwork donne 1 x Gâtrool Industriel» (Dofus pour les noobs, «Gobmichet vibre pour Gobrose»).
